source_signature.notes: Batch 4G skill 1/5. Scope Operator-derived. The bending-moment specialization of internal_loading_at_section (the signed parent that finds the full N/V/M trio at a section): this skill owns the internal bending moment M at one cut, the SigmaM=0 about the cut that determines it, the force lever arms about the cut, and the sign convention that makes M signed rather than a magnitude. Shear V at the same cut is owned by the signed sibling shear_force_internal_loading (cited, not re-solved); shear/moment diagrams (shear_moment_diagram_construction, downstream skill 3) and the load-shear-moment relations (shear_moment_load_relationships, downstream skill 2) are excluded; stress/deflection out of scope. Worked example Operator-re-derived, continuous with the shear skill's beam: simply-supported 6 m beam, P=30 kN down at 2 m, reactions Ay=20/By=10 kN given; cut at x=4 m (after the load), left portion SigmaM about the cut (CCW+): M - Ay(4) + P(2) = M - 80 + 60 = 0 -> M = +20 kN·m, sagging under the stated convention. The sign is meaningful, not a bare magnitude: Ay's CCW moment exceeds P's CW moment, netting sagging; a flipped convention or lever-arm sense gives the wrong sign. The cut is placed after the load so the nonzero-lever-arm feature bites - forgetting P gives the wrong M=80; distinguishing-feature-must-bite discipline satisfied. Opposite-segment check closes: right portion By(2)-20 = 20-20 = 0, confirming +20 CCW left face pairs with 20 CW right face. TWO-signal mapping, both content-earned: sign_or_placement_error at step 5 (the SigmaM/sign/lever-arm crux - M is meaningless without its sign), unclassified at step 7 (report/convention/diagram boundary). axis_confusion OMITTED: transverse loads, no component-resolution step. solution_sequencing_error OMITTED although live: single-cut solve with given reactions, no step strands a prerequisite unknown on an out-of-order solve - the fifth signal mapped only where earned, consistent with its omission on shear_force_internal_loading. simple_average_used omitted (Centroids-family). Opens Batch 4G; unlocks shear_moment_load_relationships (skill 2).
